Chat turns are governed model invocations through the local runtime service
(`deckent runtime
    serve`) for the model named in `terminal.chat`. session is line mode and
    also reads piped
    input; workline needs an interactive terminal on stdin and stdout.
    The scope defaults to `terminal.scopeId`. When no runtime service is
    running, the terminal
    starts one in the background; it keeps running after exit (`deckent runtime
    shutdown`).
    --full-access opens the session in full access (tool calls run without
    asking; Deckent's own
    state, policy and credentials stay closed); it needs a company grant and
    cannot be switched
    into from inside a session.
